title: Retrospective change and forward evaluation
citation: Cobb (1978), The Problem of the Nile; statsmodels distribution.
observation_unit: One annual river-volume observation, not an instantaneous discharge-rate sample.
scope_limitations: 100 annual observations, 1871–1970. A detected change is not proof of its physical cause.
acquisition: offline export from installed package distribution; no invented records
transforms: Preserved loaded values and row order; added zero-based row_id.
Calendar fields cast to integers; CO2 datetime index exported as ISO date.
Missing CO2 observations remain blank, never zero.

schema.name: row_id
schema.units: source scale; see data card (not guessed)

schema.name: volume
schema.description: Annual recorded volume; do not label as cubic metres per second.
